# ReplyTo

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Answers a call parked with Hold().

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x06` SVC_REPLY | `(ticket in r3)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err ReplyTo(Ticket t, uint32_t xlen, Handle grant);
```

**Registers:** `(xlen, grant, -1, ticket) -> r0 status`

The reply is the first `xlen` bytes of the answering thread's message box. Any thread of the space that parked the call may answer; a ticket answers once and is meaningless in other spaces. The call in hand, if any, is not affected.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `t` | in | [Ticket](../types.md#ticket) from Hold(). |
| `xlen` | in | Reply length in bytes, at most MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
| `grant` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) (with PERM_TXFR) to copy to the caller, or -1. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_NOENT`](../errors.md#err_noent) | Unknown, already answered or forged ticket, or the caller has died. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | The handle the call was received through has been closed. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | That handle lacks PERM_WAIT, or `grant` lacks PERM_TXFR. |
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../errors.md#err_overflow) | `xlen` is larger than MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
